description: Official weights (hectograms) for every species slot, from PokeAPI pokemon.csv; Blood Moon Ursaluna corrected to 333.0 kg. Palafin uses Hero Form and Dudunsparce its Two-Segment Form. dex_lbs_x10 is the value stored in the Pokedex entry (round(hg * 2.20462)). Custom species have no official weight.
